sentences.text:
Dowry Prohibition Act vs In Re: Umera Bibi & Anr on 21
February, 2023
21.02.2023 Sl. No.25 [Allowed] C. R. M. (Db) 283 of 2023 In Re: An application for bail under
Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 17.01.2023 in connection with Bhagwangola
Police Station Case No.686 of 2022 dated 29.10.2022 under Sections 498A/304B/302 of the Indian
Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act

. 
And In Re: Umera Bibi & Anr.
... ... Petitioners Mr. Ali Ahsan Alamgir Mr. Soumajit Das Majumder Ms. Soma Mal Ms. Rabia
Khatoon ... ... for the petitioners Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee .. ld.

Mr.
Parthapratim Das Mrs. Manasi Roy
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that they are in custody for about 114 days.
Learned Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail.
We have considered the materials on record.
Balancing the nature of accusation with the period of detention suffered by the petitioners, we are of the opinion further detention of the accuseds/petitioners is not necessary.

Therefore, the accuseds/petitioners, namely (1) Umera Bibi & (2) Jinnatunnesha Bibi @ Khatun, be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand only) each, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lalbagh, Murshidabad subject to condition that the said petitioners shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
In the event they fail to appear before the trial court without justifiable cause, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel their bail automatically without reference to this court.
The application for bail, thus, stands allowed.
